messages:
Maria Chen: kicking off onboarding for open-embed-v2 on our embed eval suite. run baseline (fp16) + int8 quant. dataset: 10k pairs from semantic-sim + 5k retrieval anchors (internal). goals: recall@1/5/10, silhouette for kmeans clusters, and cluster stability after quant. will share initial numbers in a bit.
Ajay Patel: nice — did you use the same normalization we discussed? l2 on outputs?
Maria Chen: yep l2 then unit-normalize. using Faiss IVF-PQ for NN searches to mimic prod indexing.
Linh Tran: can you paste the eval command you ran? I'll run a deterministic seed on my box.
Maria Chen: sure:```python eval_embeddings.py --model open-embed-v2 --quant int8 --norm l2 --index ivf_pq --seed 42 --dataset ssim_10k --k 10```
Maria Chen: quick raw outputs (int8): recall@1: 0.712, recall@5: 0.878, recall@10: 0.921, silhouette (k=50): 0.18
Maria Chen: fp16 baseline: recall@1: 0.734, recall@5: 0.889, recall@10: 0.933, silhouette: 0.205
Oliver Stone: so int8 drops ~2.2% absolute at R@1. not terrible but depends on the slice. any headroom in batch/norm differences?
Maria Chen: I sliced by query length and domain. biggest hit on short queries (<8 tokens): R@1 down 4.8% absolute. on long queries difference is <1%.
Ajay Patel: hmm maybe quantized outliers are changing nearest neighbor ordering for terse inputs. do we have similarity histogram diffs?
Maria Chen: added a quick histogram: cosine diffs (fp16 - int8) have mean ~0.02, std 0.06 but tails show 1-2% of pairs >0.2 delta.
Linh Tran: can you run a small nearest-neighbor consistency check: what fraction of top-10 overlaps between fp16 and int8?
Maria Chen: did that: top10 overlap = 0.86 (i.e., 86% average overlap) overall, but for short queries overlap=0.74.
Oliver Stone: cluster stability? silhouette drop suggests clusters get fuzzier. any examples where label flips?
Maria Chen: found ~120 anchors where cluster assignment changed across centroids (kmeans k=50). manually inspected a few — many are edge cases. attaching snippet:```anchor_id: 43821
fp16_top3: [doc_12, doc_7, doc_55]
int8_top3: [doc_7, doc_99, doc_12]
note: doc_55 gets displaced by doc_99 which is semantically close but a different subtopic.```
Ajay Patel: thanks. can we try symmetric quant (per-channel) vs global quant? might reduce those tail shifts. Also try 16-bit block quantization?
Maria Chen: plan: 1) run per-channel int8 (per-channel asym) 2) run int8 with 256-block fine-grain scaling 3) run int8 + quant-aware calibration with 1k calibration samples. scheduling now, will push results by EOD.
Linh Tran: I'll mirror the per-channel run on my machine to validate reproducibility (different hardware).
Maria Chen: FYI embed-bot logged the index build: embed-bot: Index build complete: ivf_size=1024, pq_m=32, vectors=15000, build_time=00:02:18
embed-bot: Eval job 1794523345-01 finished: model=open-embed-v2 quant=int8 per-channel recall@1=0.728 recall@5=0.885 recall@10=0.930 silhouette=0.198
Maria Chen: per-channel int8 improved R@1 to 0.728 (from 0.712) and silhouette to 0.198 — much closer to baseline. short-query R@1 gap reduced to 1.7% abs. promising.
Oliver Stone: nice improvement. do we have any significant latency or memory regressions?
Maria Chen: latency p50 token->embed: fp16 6.2ms, int8 (global) 5.1ms, int8 (per-channel) 5.4ms. memory peak reduced ~22% on global int8, ~18% per-channel.
Ajay Patel: tradeoff looks acceptable. next: A/B with small canary in dedicated cluster? we can route 5% of traffic to int8-perchannel variant with fallback to fp16 on low-confidence.
Linh Tran: low-confidence detection? threshold on max cosine or score gap?
Maria Chen: proposing dual-check: if top1_cosine < 0.18 OR (top1 - top2) < 0.02 then fallback to fp16 sync. need engineering to add sync fallback triggers.
Oliver Stone: sounds reasonable. can you create a one-pager with metrics and recommended rollout plan? I'll include in the weekly eng-ml sync.
Maria Chen: will do — draft by tomorrow morning. tagging @Ajay and @Linh for review. :eyes:
